mutants.replacement: export function parseParent(text){const m=/^00-([0-9a-f]{32})-([0-9a-f]{16})-(00|01)$/.exec(text);return m&&!/^0+$/.test(m[1])&&!/^0+$/.test(m[2])?{traceId:m[1],parentId:m[2],flags:m[3]}:null;}export function filterBaggage(text,allowed){const out=[],seen=new Set();for(const item of text.split(',')){const m=/^ *([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)=([A-Za-z0-9_.%-]*) *$/.exec(item);if(m&&!seen.has(m[1])){seen.add(m[1]);out.push(m[1]+'='+m[2]);}}return out.join(',');}
